commands.stdout:
JOPE-Dime fixtures, encode, fit/emit/search, local champions, centroid router, model bundles, dataset catalog and the product pipeline

Usage: jope [COMMAND]

Commands:
  doctor             Report current ASM capabilities and remaining qualification gaps
  benchmark          Verify and plan the private, fixed-panel benchmark
  optimize           Generate and optimize executable algorithms from the verified development panel
  verify-inputs      Verify the ten synthetic fixtures against the pinned deterministic generator
  generate-fixtures  Create the versioned synthetic corpus in a new output directory
  encode             Encode one admitted dataset with CPU Hyperion. Needs HYPERION_V7_WEIGHTS; does not download
  fit                Fit a GP genome on one admitted dataset (train R², holdout R²)
  emit               Emit working Python / Rust / C++17 / JavaScript from a GP genome
  search             Score a tiny ridge-family GP candidate set on one admitted dataset
  champions          Local champion bank over admitted fixtures. --pull/--push fail closed (no live S3)
  train-step         One local train step: fit a 128-d centroid router on champion genomes. Live --env fails closed
  route              Route one dataset through a trained local centroid router, then fit the chosen genome
  models             Model bundles: fetch, verify, publish and locate content-addressed weights
  datasets           Dataset catalog: ingest, fetch, verify and link content-addressed datasets
  pipeline           Product pipeline: dataset, prepared cuts, GP search, emitted code and a receipt
  help               Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Fit a GP genome on one admitted dataset (train R², holdout R²)

Usage: jope fit [OPTIONS] --input <INPUT>

Options:
      --input <INPUT>    
      --genome <GENOME>  [default: "(pipe X (ridge))"]
      --json             
  -h, --help             Print help

Emit working Python / Rust / C++17 / JavaScript from a GP genome

Usage: jope emit [OPTIONS] --lang <LANG>

Options:
      --genome <GENOME>  [default: "(pipe X (ridge))"]
      --lang <LANG>      rust, python, cpp17, javascript, or all
      --output <OUTPUT>  
      --json             
  -h, --help             Print help

Score a tiny ridge-family GP candidate set on one admitted dataset

Usage: jope search [OPTIONS] --input <INPUT>

Options:
      --input <INPUT>  
      --json           
  -h, --help           Print help

Product pipeline: dataset, prepared cuts, GP search, emitted code and a receipt

Usage: jope pipeline <COMMAND>

Commands:
  run             Run dataset -> prepare -> search -> select -> emit and write the receipt
  verify-receipt  Validate a receipt against the committed jope.pipeline-receipt/v1 or v2 schema
  help            Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Run dataset -> prepare -> search -> select -> emit and write the receipt

Usage: jope pipeline run [OPTIONS] --dataset <DATASET> --output <OUTPUT>

Options:
      --dataset <DATASET>    A 16-hex catalog id resolved in the local cache, or a dataset directory
      --output <OUTPUT>      Where the preparation, searches, emitted sources and receipt are written
      --budget <BUDGET>      Total per-cut budget across search and comparison (1..=1000 attempts / 1..=600 active seconds). Multiple cuts reserve half for comparison; an in-flight fit may overrun time [default: evaluations=64,seconds=300]
      --seed <SEED>          Fold seed for the cut preparation [default: 20260907]
      --rng-seed <RNG_SEED>  Seed of the search's random streams [default: 20260907]
      --cuts <CUTS>          How many of the fold partition's cuts to prepare and search (1..=5) [default: 1]
      --emit <EMIT>          Languages to emit: rust, python, cpp17, cpp20, js, or all [default: rust,python,cpp17,cpp20,js]
      --policy <POLICY>      The proposal stage: auto and skip record a skip, require fails closed [default: auto]
      --json                 Print the receipt as one JSON document
  -h, --help                 Print help

Verify and plan the private, fixed-panel benchmark

Usage: jope benchmark <COMMAND>

Commands:
  verify-manifest  Verify the approved frozen manifest; does not open dataset files or fit models
  verify-inputs    Check every development file's bytes, actual folds, labels, groups and schema
  methods          List executable Rust recipes, with aliases and configurations identified separately
  plan             Write an immutable Rust screening plan after all development inputs verify (zero fits)
  run              Execute or resume a pinned bounded campaign
  report           Authenticate retained evidence and recompute scores without fitting
  help             Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Write an immutable Rust screening plan after all development inputs verify (zero fits)

Usage: jope benchmark plan [OPTIONS] --manifest <MANIFEST> --datasets <DATASETS> --source-sha <SOURCE_SHA> --output <OUTPUT>

Options:
      --manifest <MANIFEST>      
      --datasets <DATASETS>      
      --source-sha <SOURCE_SHA>  
      --runtimes <RUNTIMES>      Add pinned runtime inventory for a bounded comparator qualification
      --output <OUTPUT>          
  -h, --help                     Print help

Execute or resume a pinned bounded campaign

Usage: jope benchmark run --plan <PLAN> --plan-sha256 <PLAN_SHA256> --manifest <MANIFEST> --datasets <DATASETS> --journal <JOURNAL>

Options:
      --plan <PLAN>                
      --plan-sha256 <PLAN_SHA256>  
      --manifest <MANIFEST>        
      --datasets <DATASETS>        
      --journal <JOURNAL>          
  -h, --help                       Print help

Authenticate retained evidence and recompute scores without fitting

Usage: jope benchmark report --plan <PLAN> --plan-sha256 <PLAN_SHA256> --manifest <MANIFEST> --datasets <DATASETS> --journal <JOURNAL>

Options:
      --plan <PLAN>                
      --plan-sha256 <PLAN_SHA256>  
      --manifest <MANIFEST>        
      --datasets <DATASETS>        
      --journal <JOURNAL>          
  -h, --help                       Print help

Generate and optimize executable algorithms from the verified development panel

Usage: jope optimize <COMMAND>

Commands:
  capabilities  Read compiled support without loading any model or admitting a budget
  proof-plan    Prepare a separately budgeted single-regression operational proof
  plan          Bind paired ASM arms and scheduling to an existing verified panel plan
  run           Execute or resume the original bounded panel window
  report        Authenticate retained fits and recompute development scores without fitting
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Prepare a separately budgeted single-regression operational proof

Usage: jope optimize proof-plan --base-plan <BASE_PLAN> --base-plan-sha256 <BASE_PLAN_SHA256> --configuration <CONFIGURATION> --configuration-sha256 <CONFIGURATION_SHA256> --dataset <DATASET> --resources <RESOURCES> --resources-sha256 <RESOURCES_SHA256> --output <OUTPUT>

Options:
      --base-plan <BASE_PLAN>                        
      --base-plan-sha256 <BASE_PLAN_SHA256>          
      --configuration <CONFIGURATION>                
      --configuration-sha256 <CONFIGURATION_SHA256>  
      --dataset <DATASET>                            
      --resources <RESOURCES>                        
      --resources-sha256 <RESOURCES_SHA256>          
      --output <OUTPUT>                              
  -h, --help                                         Print help

Bind paired ASM arms and scheduling to an existing verified panel plan

Usage: jope optimize plan --base-plan <BASE_PLAN> --base-plan-sha256 <BASE_PLAN_SHA256> --configuration <CONFIGURATION> --configuration-sha256 <CONFIGURATION_SHA256> --output <OUTPUT>

Options:
      --base-plan <BASE_PLAN>                        
      --base-plan-sha256 <BASE_PLAN_SHA256>          
      --configuration <CONFIGURATION>                
      --configuration-sha256 <CONFIGURATION_SHA256>  
      --output <OUTPUT>                              
  -h, --help                                         Print help

Dataset catalog: ingest, fetch, verify and link content-addressed datasets

Usage: jope datasets <COMMAND>

Commands:
  ingest  Enumerate, hash and de-duplicate a source tree; upload unless --dry-run
  fetch   Download a dataset id, every dataset of a task, or a collection into the cache
  verify  Re-hash cached blobs and check links; or check a committed dataset repository
  link    Seed the cache from a local tree by hashing (no download)
  schema  Print the JSON Schema derived from the Rust types
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Model bundles: fetch, verify, publish and locate content-addressed weights

Usage: jope models [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  fetch    Download a bundle (or every bundle in models/PINNED) into the cache, verifying sha256
  verify   Re-hash a populated cache; or check the committed manifests without any download
  publish  Upload a bundle's blobs create-only, then its manifest last (maintainers)
  path     Print the cache path of a bundle (or of one file in it); fails when it is not fetched
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --repo <REPO>  Checkout whose models/ directory holds committed manifests and PINNED [default: .]
  -h, --help         Print help
  -V, --version      Print version
